text:
alex: Morning all :wave: Quick standup — what I did / blockers / today.
alex: Done: received MacBook, logged into Okta, confirmed Slack + email, ran through quickstart repo.
alex: Blockers: can't push to github/redwood-inference — 403 on `git push` (SSH key added to GitHub but still blocked). Also can't access the dedicated AWS sandbox — IAM role not found. VPN seems flaky (drops after 5-10 mins).
priya: @alex welcome! I'll ping infra about the GitHub perms. Can you share the exact error output?
alex: error: remote: Permission to redwood-inference/core.git denied to alex-chen. fatal: unable to access 'https://github.com/redwood-inference/core.git/': The requested URL returned error: 403
jamal-it: @alex I checked — your GitHub SSO didn't finish. Try logging into https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference/sso and authorize. I just re-sent the SSO invite.
alex: Trying now... ok I authorized SSO. Trying `git push` again.
alex: Still 403. I also tried SSH: `ssh -T git@github.com` gives "Hi alex-chen! You've successfully authenticated, but GitHub does not provide shell access."
jamal-it: Hmm SSH auth looks fine. Are you using HTTPS remote? run `git remote -v` and paste output.
alex: remote origin https://github.com/redwood-inference/core.git (fetch)
alex: remote origin https://github.com/redwood-inference/core.git (push)
priya: Change remote to SSH: `git remote set-url origin git@github.com:redwood-inference/core.git` and try again. That should use your SSH key which is showing as ok.
alex: Switched to SSH and `git push` succeeded! :tada:
jamal-it: For AWS access — I requested the sandbox-role for your account, pending approval. You should get a confirmation in ~30m. Meanwhile try joining the VPC via Cisco AnyConnect. If it drops, send logs.
alex: AnyConnect logs: attaching snippet inline: ```[ERROR] TLS negotiated but connection lost after 8s``` — not sure if company VPN is flaky from home network.
casey: @alex thanks for the update. Blockers look clear once Jamal confirms AWS. Today focus: complete onboarding checklist (security training + first PR setup). I'll schedule a short sync if anything hangs by 4pm PST.
alex: Will do. Also quick q: where's the dotfiles repo? can't find link in the onboarding doc.
onboard-bot: Welcome! Dotfiles repo: https://git.redwood.com/dotfiles. If you need the zsh config, see `dotfiles/.zshrc`.
priya: @alex also check README in `repo-templates` for the PR label bot. Happy to walk through your first PR review later.
alex: Thanks all — feeling unblocked. I'll open a tiny PR to tweak the README to verify CI runs. End."
